svg.text: Movement to the right, after the book's figure 13
right[j] fires when front[j] fired a moment ago (through slow[j])
and front[j+1] fires now. left[j] is the mirror image: slow[j+1] and front[j].
A thing moving right: its front edge is in column j for 0.4 s, then in column j+1
The same thing moving left: front[j+1] first, then front[j]
